title: glm lane: Z.ai server-side builtins fire on degenerate invocations during tool-confusion; done-note path under-discoverable
wanted_capability: Two coupled needs surfaced by transcript forensics (session d98ee38a item 182): (1) a way to suppress Z.ai's server-side built-in tools (web_search_prime) for dispatched code bros — the model, flailing for the bbox_note emission path, emitted six degenerate server_tool_use invocations with search_query="test" plus self-generated markdown mimicking a tool-execution UI, all executed server-side mid-stream; the harness never requested web_search. Need a provider/request knob (or harness-side filter if Z.ai exposes one) to disable builtins on the glm lane. (2) note/done-note discoverability under code_mode: bbox_note lives behind the exec surface (note() idiom) and the model only found it after the websearch flail — the pinned-tool guidance or brief template should state the exec-note path explicitly for code_mode sessions.
fallback_used: Brief-level "do NOT call web_search or Z.ai built-ins" prohibition on subsequent glm resumes (symptom treatment); model self-recovered via exec note() after six degenerate calls.
evidence: session d98ee38a snapshot item 182: 6x server_tool_use web_search_prime {search_query: test} in one assistant turn, then items 183-185 exec cell -> note emitted
notes: CORRECTION (operator review, 2026-06-10, w8/harness-fixes): the facet-1 claim "the harness never requested web_search" is FALSE. The harness injects the server-side web_search tool by default on every Anthropic-transport request (anthropic.rs build_body, gated by TurnOpts.web_search, default true via BRO_HARNESS_WEB_SEARCH at agent_loop). Z.ai renders that offer as its web_search_prime builtin. Session d98ee38a evidence: all six degenerate calls sit in ONE assistant message (snapshot item 182, search_query="test"), and the session's first tool call was tool_search hunting for bbox_note — a lost model pulling the nearest offered lever, not a provider forcing builtins. ROOT CAUSE was facet 2 (exec-note discoverability), fixed in the code-mode exec/wait descriptions (exec-note idiom + "do not search the web for it"). A lane-wide default-off for glm was implemented and then REVERTED by operator decision (62c19c1) as capability sabotage treating a symptom; what landed instead: BRO_HARNESS_WEB_SEARCH now resolves through the per-session env resolver, so the knob is operator-scoped (account env / per-dispatch env_overrides) and actually reachable for in-process dispatches. If degenerate server-side searches recur AFTER the discoverability fix, that evidence would justify revisiting a lane default.
